description_en: Modifies the basic information of an authorization rule
description_zh: 修改授权规则基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-rule --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zmb2y9ydw08 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-id 68 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host whose authorization rule you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的授权规则所在堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the authorization rule to modify belongs.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要修改授权规则所在的堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the authorization rule to modify
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the authorization rule. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), single quotation marks ('), and spaces. It cannot start with a special character
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的授权规则名称。长度为1~128个字符，不能以特殊字符开头，只可包含特殊字符中的半角句号（）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）、半角单引号（'）以及空格
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The new remarks of the authorization rule. It can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后授权规则的备注信息，最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The start time of the new validity period of the authorization rule. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权规则有效期开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）
parameters.name: effective_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the new validity period of the authorization rule. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权规则有效期结束时间（秒，时间戳格式）
parameters.name: effective_end_time

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the users with whom the modified authorization rule is associated
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权规则关联的用户ID列表
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the user groups with which the modified authorization rule is associated
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权规则关联的用户组ID列表
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: An array that consists of the host IDs and host account IDs with which the modified authorization rule is associated
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权规则关联的主机ID与主机账户ID数组
parameters.name: hosts

parameters.help_en: The databases and database accounts that a user associated with the modified rule can manage
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权的数据库实例和数据库账户列表
parameters.name: databases

fields.help_en: The names of the asset accounts
fields.name: host_account_names

parameters.help_en: The asset groups and asset accounts that a user associated with the modified rule can manage
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权的资产组和账户列表
parameters.name: host_groups

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
